title: Nature Rock Boulder Basalt Mossy
description:
The ‘Tundra Icelandic’ themed assets capture the raw, otherworldly feel of a volcanic landscape. Featuring high-fidelity scans of moss-covered boulders and varied rock formations, this collection reflects a landscape shaped by geological activity and harsh climate.
Ideal for creating dramatic, natural terrain with a strong sense of scale, realism, and environmental storytelling.
